description:
Takes the same arguments as planify_create_post and reports whether they would be accepted. Creates nothing, publishes nothing.

Use it when a post is close to a limit, or when a platform has rules you are unsure you have satisfied — it is cheaper than finding out by leaving a failed draft in someone's queue. Returns errors with the field, the rule and the numbers, plus warnings for things that would be silently ignored (alt text a platform will not deliver, a thread on a platform without threads).

Content and settings only: plan limits and quotas are checked when the post is actually created, so a valid result is not a guarantee the create call will succeed. planify_me covers the plan side.

channel_ids.description: Required when content is a string.

media.description: Attachments with alt text, in order. Use instead of media_urls when any has alt text.

type.description: Default draft. Affects whether scheduled_at is required.

name: planify_validate_post
title: Planify: check a post without creating it
